description: Free. Reads the USDT TRC20 contract live and reports whether Tether has blacklisted (frozen) a TRON address. Point-in-time result. Limited per caller per UTC day; failed reads still count toward the limit.

address.description: Public TRON address (base58 T-address, e.g. TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t).

name: check_tron_usdt_blacklist
title: Check TRON USDT blacklist
